basic_profile.bio: Hailing from the scenic foothills of Colorado, ScifiSkeptic32 is a tech enthusiast by day and an adventurer by weekend. A software developer at a mid-sized tech firm, they spend their weekdays knee-deep in code, while weekends are reserved for hiking the Colorado trails. Despite a busy work schedule, they find time to delve into the world of science fiction, often critiquing movies from their home setup. Single and living with a rescue dog named Comet, they enjoy late-night Reddit browsing, often active during the hours of 9 PM to midnight MST.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: ScifiSkeptic32 boasts a solid foundation in computer science, having graduated from a reputable university. Their love for technology is complemented by a keen interest in post-apocalyptic fiction, which they explore through books and films. They have self-taught knowledge in film critique, often drawing from online courses and community discussions.
